objective: Construct and freeze a fresh, unseen decisive cohort and evaluator for a post-retrieval K=3 selector experiment without exposing the frozen selector implementation, development results, expected outcomes, or answer-bearing prior cases before the cohort/gold/evaluator freeze.

opaque_target_identity.note: These identities may be recorded before freeze but their contents are forbidden until authorized reveal.

pre_reveal_denylist: PR #82 body, comments, diff, checks, artifacts, or branch narrative
PR #77 selector results or its answer-bearing artifacts
PR #63 answer-bearing selector/retrieval artifacts except where explicitly re-authorized after freeze
normal CAL Pipeline conversation history, saved summaries, or project-memory summaries about this selector experiment
broad repository search used to discover selector-development material
any frozen target source bytes before the prereveal freeze receipt is committed
pre_reveal_allowed_knowledge: The system under test chooses at most three items from a fixed depth-10 first-stage candidate pool.
The fresh cohort should discriminate robust candidate selection from ordinary ranking without being tailored to any hidden implementation.
The profile input schema in FRESH-COHORT-CONTRACT.md is part of the experiment input contract.
Four opaque execution arms will be compared after freeze; their implementation mapping is not required for authoring.
required_prereveal_outputs: claim/profile inputs authored without target access
preregistered thresholds and terminal disposition rules
freeze receipt identifying exact bytes/hashes and declaring denylist compliance
freeze_rule: No target implementation, target development record, prior answer-bearing selector result, or post-reveal arm mapping may be opened until all prereveal outputs are frozen and the freeze receipt is committed.
contamination_rule: If any denylisted target/development/answer-bearing source is opened before freeze, stop. Preserve an exposure record. Do not continue the same execution under an independence claim.
post_freeze_reveal: After a valid prereveal freeze, return the input/evaluator freeze identity and sealed-gold identity to the normal CAL Pipeline lane. The execution lane runs the frozen target and controls without opening gold, freezes arm outputs, then gold is revealed for evaluation.
nonclaims: This bootstrap does not qualify or promote the selector.
The opaque target identity is not evidence of correctness.
Context-free authoring establishes only the information aperture documented by its receipts; a fresh thread alone is not sufficient.
